description: PlanIn BI Matrix is an advanced, interactive Power BI custom visual tailored for data-driven professionals in planning, forecasting, and strategic decision-making. This matrix visual extends Power BI’s built-in functionality by enabling users to edit and write data directly within the Power BI Service environment. Designed to handle complex data entry and planning workflows, PlanIn BI Matrix empowers organizations to streamline operations, improve accuracy, and enhance data collaboration across teams. PlanIn BI Matrix brings an integrated write-back capability to Power BI, making it ideal for managing and analyzing data in real-time. Users can leverage this tool for diverse planning and forecasting scenarios, including sales projections, inventory management, financial planning, production scheduling, and project planning. Its interactive design ensures teams have an accessible, collaborative platform for seamless data updates and adjustments without leaving the Power BI environment. Fully supported in Power BI Service, this visual does not function on Power BI Desktop. The PlanIn BI Matrix requires an additional Power BI visual, PlanIn BI - Data Refresh Service (available on AppSource), to enable real-time data refresh capabilities.
